verify: type an uppercase slash command variant and confirm it dispatches identically to lowercase; slugify a Turkish backlog title and confirm no character-drop collision

title: anthropic.ts's parallel tool_use round-trip splits sibling tool_results into separate consecutive user messages instead of one combined message, violating the API's expected tool-loop shape
spec: Combine all sibling tool_result blocks from one parallel tool_use round into a single user message (matching Anthropic's message-shape contract) instead of emitting one user message per tool_result.
verify: trigger a turn with 2+ parallel tool calls and confirm the follow-up request sends one combined user message, not N separate ones; the Anthropic API accepts it without a 400

title: /model and /provider bypass the busy gate and can splice two backends into one in-flight native-agent turn (distinct from the already-fixed 'switch reported success but silently no-op'ed' incident bug)
spec: Gate /model and /provider switches behind the same busy-check other mutating commands respect, so a switch mid-turn can't splice a different backend into an already-in-flight request/response cycle. Note: this is a genuinely different bug from the same-day incident fix (confirmed live and working via getAdapter/getModel getters) where the switch was previously a silent no-op — this is a race on an otherwise-working switch, not a repeat of that fixed bug.
verify: start a long-running turn, immediately issue /model <other>, and confirm the in-flight turn either completes on its original backend or is cleanly cancelled — never a spliced mixed-backend response

title: approval-terminal-channel.ts's dispose() detaches the relay channel but leaves the closure-captured decisionHandler live, risking a double-invocation on a later decide() call
spec: Null out or otherwise invalidate the captured decisionHandler reference inside dispose() so a decide() call after disposal cannot still fire the stale handler.
verify: dispose a channel, then call decide() again and confirm no stale handler executes

title: deckent_bash hardening — no timeout/cancellation for a hanging shell command, and hardcodes spawn('bash', ...) which fails on native Windows without WSL/Git-Bash
spec: Add a timeout+cancellation path so a hanging shell command doesn't freeze the current turn indefinitely; make the shell binary selection platform-aware (cmd.exe/PowerShell on native Windows) instead of hardcoding 'bash' (part of the broader Windows-native breakage cluster, born-579).
verify: run a deliberately-hanging shell command and confirm the turn recovers via timeout; on a native-Windows CI runner confirm deckent_bash doesn't ENOENT

title: chat-tool-exec.ts's inScope() path-traversal guard is purely lexical (path.relative) and never resolves symlinks — a symlink pointing outside scope can bypass the write-scope boundary
spec: Resolve symlinks (fs.realpath) before the lexical relative-path scope check so a symlink can't be used to write outside the declared scope.
verify: create a symlink inside scope pointing to a file outside scope, attempt a write through it, and confirm the guard rejects it

title: deckent_edit_file silently replaces only the FIRST occurrence of `old`, and an empty/missing `old` silently no-ops instead of erroring
spec: Either require old to uniquely match exactly once (erroring on 0 or 2+ matches, matching the Edit-tool convention elsewhere in this codebase) or add an explicit replace-all option; make empty/missing old raise a visible error instead of a silent no-op.
verify: call deckent_edit_file with an old string that matches twice and confirm an error, not a silent first-only replace

title: chat-tool-bridge.ts's '[mcp-error] tool not allowed: <name>' message is returned identically for genuinely-disallowed tools and for allowed tools that simply crashed, hiding the real failure

verify: crash an allowed tool and confirm the error message differs from a genuine permission-denial message

title: chat-permissions.ts's writePermissions overwrites permissions.allow from the in-memory Set only, losing concurrent grants written by another process
spec: Read-merge-write instead of blind-overwrite: re-read the on-disk permissions.allow immediately before writing and union with the in-memory Set, so a concurrent grant from another process/session isn't silently lost.
verify: grant a permission from two concurrent sessions and confirm both grants survive in the final settings.local.json

title: chat-render-region.ts's writeAbove only clears the current terminal row before redrawing, leaving stale content when the pinned input region grows across a redraw

title: chat-render-region.ts's safePrompt swallows ALL exceptions from rl.prompt(true), not just the documented 'readline was closed' case

title: agent/loop.ts cancel() robustness — cannot interrupt a tool handler already in flight, and mid-batch cancellation can leave orphaned tool_use blocks with no matching tool_result
